# Claims Assessment Memo

## Summary

Zephyr Point Media Ltd (policy CC-1481) reported on 20 April 2026 the theft of a 3D printer and filament stock from a locked van at a shared workshop on Tanner Row [notice of loss]. The theft was reported to the police on 22 April 2026 [police report]. The loss falls within clause 4.2 (Contents) and the locked-container exception to exclusion 7.1 applies. Two points cannot be confirmed from the file: the premises named in the schedule, and the date of the theft for exclusion 7.5. The decision is covered under clause 4.2, subject to those two confirmations. The reserve is 6,264 dollars.

## Facts

- The insured is Zephyr Point Media Ltd, under policy CC-1481 [notice of loss].
- The loss was reported on 20 April 2026 [notice of loss].
- The loss is theft from a locked van of a 3D printer and filament stock [notice of loss].
- The location is a shared workshop on Tanner Row [notice of loss; police report].
- The police report, reference CR/2026/4169, is dated 22 April 2026 and was made by Zephyr Point Media Ltd [police report].
- The police report records the items as a 3D printer and filament stock [police report].
- The police report records that the items were in a locked container at the time [police report].
- The 3D printer was supplied by Beacon Office Supply at 5,181 dollars [invoice 1].
- The filament stock was supplied by Crane & Sons Electronics at 1,083 dollars [invoice 2].
- The file contains no policy schedule, and the date of the theft is not stated in any document in the file.

## Coverage analysis

**Insuring clause.** Clause 4.2 covers loss of business contents caused by theft at the premises named in the schedule, and at any other premises while in the insured's custody [policy cl. 4.2]. The loss is theft of business contents [notice of loss; police report]. The schedule is not in the file, so it cannot be confirmed whether Tanner Row is a named premises. If it is not, cover depends on the items being in the insured's custody there. The reports place the items in the insured's locked van at that location [notice of loss; police report].

**Other cover clauses.** Clause 4.5 (Transit) is not relied on, as nothing in the file shows an employee carrying the equipment between premises. Clauses 4.7 (Escape of water) and 4.9 (Electrical surge) do not apply to a theft loss [policy cl. 4.7, 4.9].

**Exclusions**
- **Clause 7.1 (Unattended property).** Theft of portable equipment left unattended in a shared or public space is excluded unless the equipment was in a locked container or locked room [policy cl. 7.1]. The location is a shared workshop [notice of loss]. The police report records that the items were in a locked container at the time [police report]. The exception applies, so the exclusion does not bar the claim.
- **Clause 7.3 (Wear and tear).** Gradual deterioration is excluded [policy cl. 7.3]. The loss is a theft, not deterioration [notice of loss; police report]. The exclusion does not apply.
- **Clause 7.5 (Unproven loss).** A theft loss not reported to the police within seven days is excluded [policy cl. 7.5]. The police report is dated 22 April 2026 [police report], and the loss was notified to us on 20 April 2026 [notice of loss], so the theft occurred on or before 20 April. The theft date is not in the file, so the seven-day period cannot be calculated. The exclusion cannot be cleared until that date is confirmed.

## Decision

**Covered** under clause 4.2 (Contents) [policy cl. 4.2]. Exclusion 7.1 does not apply because of its locked-container exception [policy cl. 7.1; police report]. Exclusion 7.3 does not apply [policy cl. 7.3]. This decision is subject to two confirmations before payment:
1. The policy schedule, to confirm the named premises and any excess.
2. The date of the theft, to confirm the police report was made within seven days under clause 7.5.

If the theft date shows the report was made outside seven days, the claim is not covered under clause 7.5.

## Reserve

Under clause 9.1, the reserve is the sum of the invoices in the file, less the excess of 250 dollars where the schedule applies one. Where no excess is shown in the schedule, none applies [policy cl. 9.1].

| Item | Amount (dollars) |
|---|---|
| 3D printer [invoice 1] | 5,181 |
| Filament stock [invoice 2] | 1,083 |
| **Sum of invoices** | **6,264** |
| Excess | none shown |
| **Reserve** | **6,264** |

No schedule is in the file, so no excess is shown and none is applied. If the schedule applies the 250 dollar excess, the reserve reduces to 6,014 dollars.
